Id.description: Unique identifier of the credit card.

CustomerId.description: Unique identifier of the credit card owner (`Customer`).

IsActive.description: Whether the credit card is still active.

ObfuscatedNumber.description: Obfuscated credit card number. At most first six digits and last four digits can be specified, otherwise the digits are replaced with `*`.

Expiration.description: Expiration of the credit card in format `MM/YYYY`.

CreatedUtc.description: Creation date and time of the credit card in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the credit card in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.
